gaps.description: The doc says patterns get names but defines no pattern type, match result or named-group access; `match of ... against ...` and `header of m` are invented.
Failures in the doc are bare names; there is no way to attach data to a failure, so `fail with X with file as ... and lineno as ...` is invented.

gaps.construct: self._handle_header / self._handle_option resolved on the instance, overridable by subclasses
gaps.description: No methods, interfaces or overriding; the calls are bound statically to one operation, losing subclass extension.
No module constants or singleton objects; replaced by a choice Section_name with an Unnamed variant, which changes the type of the header argument.

gaps.construct: method on self reading self._allow_unnamed_section and self.SECTCRE
gaps.description: The receiver becomes an explicit labelled parameter; SECTCRE is a class attribute in Python but has to become an instance field.

gaps.construct: `if not mo and st.cursect is None: raise` followed by `handle_header if mo else handle_option`
gaps.description: A maybe can only be opened with choose, so the guard and the dispatch must be merged into one choose with a nested if; the result is correct but the structure differs from the original.

gaps.construct: constructing a choice value with a payload: Named with name as header of m
gaps.description: The doc shows constructing payload-free variants and `some x`, but not how to build a variant with fields in an expression.

gaps.construct: exceptions propagating from helpers without being declared
gaps.description: The `fails with` list has to guess the helper failures; the doc does not say whether a failure name can carry data or be a family of related errors.

invented_syntax: match of sectcre of parser against clean of line
fail with MissingSectionHeaderError with file as fpname and lineno as lineno of st and line as line
Named with name as header of m (variant construction in an expression)
notes: The control flow translates cleanly, and the choose on mo arguably reads better than Python's conditional-expression-as-statement. The real costs are the missing regex vocabulary and failures that cannot carry data, both of which every parser needs. Label words get crowded with four parameters (`handle_header st with Unnamed for fpname in parser`), and `with` here collides with the `with` of variant payloads.
